decisions.rationale: Refers to the enzyme glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase and its variant forms (protein/gene variants), not to a disease name.

decisions.rationale: 'Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency' names one specific enzymopathy with a single definition; the parenthetical abbreviation stays inside the one span, as with 'von Hippel-Lindau (VHL) disease'.

decisions.rationale: 'G6PD variants' refers generically to enzyme/gene variants, not to a named disease.

decisions.rationale: 'G6PD Distrito Federal' is the name of an electrophoretic enzyme variant (a genetic variant), not a disease.

decisions.rationale: 'G6PD A-' denotes a gene/allele (the text refers to 'these G6PD A- genes' and mutations characteristic of it), not a disease name.

decisions.rationale: 'G6PD deficiency' is a named specific disease, as in 'Two other Mexican males with G6PD deficiency', with one definition and no further categorization.
'G6PD A' here denotes a gene/genotype haplotype marker (e.g., the haplotype characteristic of G6PD A- in Africa), not a disease.
